likelihood.description: Chance that the threat manifests as described over the lifetime of the setup (horizon_years), before looking at our measures.

vulnerability.description: Chance that the threat gets through our measures and causes its outcome. 0 = reliably prevented, or detected and answered in time; 4 = no effective protection.

severity.description: Worst credible outcome; loss means lost or stolen, which is not distinguished.

bands.label: inconvenience, or latent fault with margin left
latent fault without margin, or temporary lock-out of main funds
privacy loss, loss of auxiliary funds, or an owner loses every way to the main funds

inconvenience.description: Nothing is lost; a recovery action is needed.

latent_margin.description: A fault is present, but no single further failure makes funds unusable or stolen.

latent_no_margin.description: A fault is present and one further failure makes funds unusable or stolen.

lockout_temporary.description: Main funds cannot be used for now (delay, unavailable parts, missing descriptor) but nothing is lost for good.

privacy_loss.description: Holdings or structure of the setup become known to others.

owner_access_lost.description: An owner loses every way to the main funds while another owner keeps one.

aux_loss.description: Auxiliary (tripwire) funds are lost or stolen.

main_loss.description: Main funds are lost or stolen.

protection.description: Vulnerability = 4 - protection. Protection comes from the strongest mechanism that is present in the setup; a prevention and a detection together add a bonus.

setup_check.description: A check done at setup finds every fault that was made at or before setup almost surely: a restore test shows a wrong backup, a test transaction a wrong policy.

after_delay.description: Protection against an attacker who can spend only after the delay of a policy has passed: a mechanism that keeps the funds from ever reaching that delay (refreshing them in time) counts with these values; detections count with any schedule, there is time to react.

risk_matrix.description: Rows: residual likelihood 0 to 4. Columns: severity 0 to 4. Values: risk 0 to 4.
